title: Repairing Speech Access After Text Updates with Frozen Affine Fields
abstract: arXiv:2610.20253v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speech-capable language models inherit most of their knowledge from text-rich language backbones, and continued model maintenance is likewise dominated by text updates. Knowledge acquired through a text update can nevertheless remain difficult to access when the same query is spoken. We formulate this mismatch as post-update speech access repair, where the knowledge-bearing checkpoint stays frozen and a detachable operator repairs speech-only access in one model pass. We introduce Affine Fields for Interface Repair across Modalities (AFFIRM), which first learns and freezes a base correction for speech hidden states, then adds query-specific corrections with zero mean over the operator-training queries. Paired speech and text states provide the coordinates that condition these corrections on each query. On balanced synthetic-speech PopQA, paired comparisons do not establish a clear advantage for AFFIRM over global SALSA steering or low-ra

translated_title: 使用冻结仿射场修复文本更新后的语音访问
translated_abstract: 具备语音能力的语言模型的大部分知识继承自富文本的语言骨干网络，持续的模型维护同样以文本更新为主导。然而，通过文本更新获得的知识，在相同查询以语音形式提出时仍可能难以访问。我们将这种不匹配表述为“更新后语音访问修复”：承载知识的模型检查点保持冻结，由一个可拆卸的算子通过单次模型前向传播修复纯语音访问。我们提出了跨模态接口修复的仿射场方法（AFFIRM），该方法首先学习并冻结针对语音隐藏状态的基础校正，随后添加在算子训练查询上均值为零的查询特定校正。成对的语音与文本状态提供坐标，将校正条件化到每个查询上。在平衡的合成语音PopQA数据集上，成对比较并未确定AFFIRM相对于全局SALSA导向方法或低秩（摘要在此处截断）……的明显优势。
tldr: 提出AFFIRM方法，在保持模型检查点完全冻结的前提下，通过可拆卸的仿射场算子（冻结的基础校正加上零均值的查询特定校正）修复文本更新后新知识在语音查询时难以访问的问题。
en_tdlr: AFFIRM repairs speech-only access to knowledge acquired through text updates by learning a frozen base correction plus zero-mean query-specific affine corrections, keeping the knowledge-bearing model checkpoint frozen.
